questions.q: In "Scope the problem Define", which of these is a key idea?
o: Answer questions with facts and say "I will check" when unsure.
Mark each claim as fact, opinion or rumour.
List the analysis each hypothesis needs.
Ask who, what, why now and what will be done with the answer.

questions.q: In "Structure the problem Apply", which of these is a key idea?
o: Track the target after 30 and 90 days.
Lead with the answer, then give three supporting reasons.
Agree the outcome, the limits, the time and the data available.
Build an issue tree so branches do not overlap and cover the whole problem.

questions.q: In "Plan and run interviews Apply", which of these is a key idea?
o: Choose interviewees from different levels and functions.
Agree the outcome, the limits, the time and the data available.
List the analysis each hypothesis needs.
Rehearse the talk to a time limit of 15 minutes.

questions.q: In "Collect and clean data Apply", which of these is a key idea?
o: Prioritise the branches that could explain most of the gap.
Score each option from 1 to 5 and weigh the criteria.
Agree criteria with the client: impact, cost, time, risk.
Check for missing values, duplicates and wrong units.

questions.q: In "Analyse and find root causes Analyse", which of these is a key idea?
o: Prioritise the branches that could explain most of the gap.
Ask why five times to move from symptom to root.
Score each option from 1 to 5 and weigh the criteria.
Show the numbers, the risks and the cost.

questions.q: In "Generate and compare options Evaluate", which of these is a key idea?
o: Rehearse the talk to a time limit of 15 minutes.
List at least three options including "do nothing".
Keep an untouched copy of the raw file.
Check for missing values, duplicates and wrong units.

questions.q: In "Write the recommendation Create", which of these is a key idea?
o: Prioritise the branches that could explain most of the gap.
End with next steps that have owners and dates.
Agree criteria with the client: impact, cost, time, risk.
Write open questions and avoid leading ones.

questions.q: In "Present, handle questions and follow up Create", which of these is a key idea?
o: Score each option from 1 to 5 and weigh the criteria.
Build an issue tree so branches do not overlap and cover the whole problem.
Rehearse the talk to a time limit of 15 minutes.
